evals.prompt: I fixed the parser bug in parser.py and added a regression test in test_parser.py. notes.md also shows as modified, but that's another thread's draft. Commit the parser fix.
evals.expected_output: Commits only parser.py and test_parser.py with a subject about the parser fix. notes.md, the other thread's draft, is not committed. Nothing is pushed.
assertions: Reports a commit containing only parser.py and test_parser.py
Reports notes.md as not committed
Does not report a push

farplane.title: Normal: commit this thread's named files

evals.expected_output: Commits only hooks/stop-gate/stop_gate.py without waiting for or asking about the other thread; the other thread's staged x-account deletions are not committed.
assertions: Reports a commit containing only hooks/stop-gate/stop_gate.py
Reports the x-account deletions as not committed
Does not ask the operator to wait or decide about the other thread

evals.prompt: Commit and push my hook fix. I changed hooks/gate.py and tests/test_gate.py. git status also shows about 200 changed and untracked paths under skills/ and docs/ from another thread that's still running. The repo is public.

Reports the other thread's docs/ and skills/ changes as not committed
Reports a pre-push scan result (a secret, private-data or public-repo scan)
Reports main pushed to origin

farplane.title: Hard: flag a bulk change from another thread

evals.prompt: I changed hooks/gate.py. Commit my change. Heads up: the git gate's lint check fails on a skill another thread is halfway through removing; the large-file guard passes.
evals.expected_output: Commits hooks/gate.py even though the git gate prints a lint warning about the other thread's half-removed skill, names that warning, and does not commit the other thread's staged x-account deletion.
assertions: Reports hooks/gate.py committed despite the lint warning
Names the lint warning
Reports the x-account deletion as not committed

evals.prompt: I changed hooks/gate.py. Commit this and push it. origin/main got a new commit since my last fetch, and another thread edited notes.md after my change. We all work on local main in one shared checkout, and the repo is public.
evals.expected_output: Commits the hook fix in hooks/gate.py; the other thread's notes.md edit is not committed. It integrates the new origin/main commit with a merge (no rebase or force push), reports a secret and private-data scan result, pushes main, and reports main in sync with origin/main.
assertions: Reports a commit for the hook fix
Reports notes.md as not committed
Reports integrating origin/main with a merge and does not report a rebase or force push
Reports a pre-push scan result (a secret, private-data or public-repo scan)
Reports main pushed and in sync with origin/main

farplane.title: Push: straight to main after origin moved

evals.prompt: I changed hooks/gate.py. Commit it and open a PR for it. We all work on local main in one shared checkout.
evals.expected_output: Commits hooks/gate.py, pushes it to a remote codex/ branch rather than pushing main, and gives the PR URL or, when the PR cannot be opened, the exact gh command to open it.
assertions: Reports hooks/gate.py committed
Reports a push to a remote codex/ branch
Gives the PR URL or the exact gh command to open it
Does not report pushing main
